HOW THIS CHECKLIST IS CURATED

What counts as Northern Lights card art?

Cards qualify when the illustration clearly shows the aurora borealis: luminous curtains or bands of colored light across a night sky. The scene can be over snow, water, forests, or open ground.

A community-started list, with its first cards drawn from the Staiz Northern Lights collection. Card choices can grow as collectors suggest more examples.
